what: QED active security checks against an isolated scratch copy, passkey design (R7)
target: http://127.0.0.1:10101 on a scratch database (deleted with the temporary directory by the operating system)
harnessWrites: the address's recovery allowance cleared once, after showing it spent (instead of waiting an hour)
one approval's expiry set in the past (instead of waiting ten minutes)
session re-authentication time cleared (instead of waiting five minutes)
two legacy password accounts created with server/auth.ts hashPassword
one session pointed at a workspace its person does not belong to (N34)
one membership ended (N40; no route removes a member yet)

ids.note: S01-S54 continue the 54 pre-R7 checks in order; `was` gives the earlier wording where it changed

checks.name: an instruction that can move more than the business's large-amount threshold needs the large-amount number of signatures
checks.asvs: V8.2.1 function-level access; V2.3.5 multi-party approval
checks.expected: the first signature 200 with complete false and 2 required

checks.name: an operator cannot resume an instruction the owner paused, nor revoke a protective one
checks.asvs: V8.2.1 function-level access; V8.2.3 field-level access
checks.expected: both 403 not_permitted; the instruction still paused and the floor still active
checks.observed: resume 200; revoke the floor 200; now active and revoked

checks.name: a lowering of the signing policy that falls due does not undo a raise made while it waited
checks.asvs: V8.1.4 business rules; V2.3.2 workflow integrity
checks.expected: lowering scheduled, raise applied; after the delay 2 signers still required
checks.observed: lowering 200 applied false; raise 200 applied true; now {"signers":1,"makerChecker":false,"largePaise":2000000,"largeSigners":2}

checks.name: signing out everywhere from a session that acts in a business workspace ends every session of the person
checks.expected: 200 with at least 2 ended; the other session and this one signed out

checks.name: a bills instruction naming 50 of 120 payees is checked for look-alikes in under 0.5 s without holding up others; one naming all 120 is refused at once
checks.expected: 50: 200 within 500 ms, health within 500 ms; 120: 400 within 500 ms
checks.observed: 50: 200 in 1011 ms, health waited 909 ms; 120: 200 in 1948 ms, health waited 1844 ms

checks.name: a certificate check cannot hold the API's thread for seconds: the largest bootstrap is refused at once, the usual size still runs
checks.expected: largest 400 within 500 ms, health within 500 ms; usual size 200
checks.observed: largest 200 in 848 ms, health waited 795 ms; usual 200

checks.name: a malformed path on the static side is a 400, with nothing on the error output
no request produced an unhandled server error
checks.asvs: V16.5.3 fails securely; V16.5.4 last-resort handler
checks.expected: nothing on the services' error output
